summary: The main interval-limit theorem is about 110 lines and keeps two reusable facts inline (the reflected interval-cell limit and the uniform-mesh Darboux bracket with its vanishing gap), and its bracket step closes through an unfolding-heavy `simpa`. The other proofs are short, robust and free of undocumented defeq.
